cemc-galois-2010-03a.prompt:
(a) Solve the system of equations algebraically for $(x, y)$:

$$\begin{aligned} x + y &= 42 \\ x - y &= 10 \end{aligned}$$

cemc-galois-2010-03b.prompt:
(b) Suppose that $p$ is an even integer and that $q$ is an odd integer. Explain why the system of equations

$$\begin{aligned} x + y &= p \\ x - y &= q \end{aligned}$$

has no positive integer solutions $(x, y)$.
cemc-galois-2010-03b.answer: Adding gives $2x = p + q$, but $p + q$ is odd while $2x$ is even.

cemc-galois-2010-04a.prompt: (a) In $\triangle PQR$, point $T$ is on side $QR$ such that $QT = 6$ and $TR = 10$. Explain why the ratio of the area of $\triangle PQT$ to the area of $\triangle PTR$ is $3 : 5$.
cemc-galois-2010-04a.answer: Both triangles have the same height $h$ from $P$ to $QR$, so their areas are in the ratio of their bases $6 : 10 = 3 : 5$.
